title: Discord webhook call returns 204 with no body so the message ID is never available
symptoms: Response body is empty and there is no message ID to edit later
A failed save returns success with nothing posted
cause: Execute Webhook defaults wait to false, which returns 204 and does not report a message that was not saved. Without wait=true there is no message object to store.
fix: Add wait=true to the query string when you need the created message or need to know the send failed.
affected: Discord API v10 Execute Webhook, as of 2026-10
